guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables and code blocks without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table/thead/th foundation; wrapper handles overflow locally; adapt by container, keep header-data relationships.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all tables use th header cells inside .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto; overscroll-behavior-inline:contain} so wide compat/propdef tables scroll locally instead of widening the page; cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native scroll-target-group/:target-current scrollspy pattern; communicate active state semantically (aria-current).

openQuestions: Box placement for a bare mode keyword (scroll-marker-group: links with no before/after) is grammatically valid but the spec prose read on 2026-10-04 defines placement only for before/after; the pages advise always specifying a position keyword. Re-check when the CSSWG resolves issue #12122 follow-ups.

What focus order and roles pre-154 Chrome (135–153) gave scroll markers is not stated in the sources read; the Intent to Ship only discusses the compat risk of fixing the default. The default-mode section says so rather than guessing.
BCD has no css.properties.scroll-marker-group.links/.tabs subfeatures yet; compat rows for the modes are labelled interim ChromeStatus data and should be replaced with BCD quotes when entries land.
Edge support for the modes is recorded as unknown: BCD 'edge: mirror' covers only the base property, and no Edge-specific evidence for 154-era modes was found.
